visual.floja: Akashinga is ecocentric because they like animals. They also help women.
visual.porque: Ecocentric is right, but ‘they like animals’ is not evidence, and no source is used: 1/4.
puntos: Ecocentric values, with evidence: biodiversity, migratory pathways
Social values: local development, 62 % to communities
Community-centred stewardship, with evidence from the sources
visual.clave: Name the value, then quote the source

diagrama.titulo: Akashinga as a reinforcing loop (model answer for Q5b)

visual.mal: Chernobyl (1986) created most of Europe’s green parties.
visual.bien: Many existed before 1986 (German Greens, 1980). Chernobyl strengthened anti-nuclear opinion and support for green parties.
